aboutme.title: I'm Daniel Mihaylov
aboutme.subtitle: I'm 23 years old UX/UI Designer and Front-end Developer, graduated Industrial designer in Technical university of Varna and now I'm studying my master's degree at the same university! Currently I work as Web designer and developer and I'm using software from Adobe cloud, Figma, Shoppify and Wordpress. I also code on HTML/CSS/JS(with ReactJS)/.liquid.

job-1.description: Creating visual content for websites, social networks, online stores, emails and digital campaigns all manage by agile methodology. Development of graphic elements, banners, headers, animations, mockups, advertising visions and product visualizations. Work on the design of web interfaces (UX/UI). Photo processing preparation for online publications and advertising. Maintaining and developing visual brand identity, adhering to corporate guidelines for style and consistency. Website optimization for better user experience and SEO. Close collaboration with web team, marketing team, grpahic designers, illustrators, project manager in the implementation of online campaigns, new product lines and promotions

job-2.description: As Interior designer at Lazur, I was responsible for creating functional and aesthetically pleasing interior spaces that met the needs and preferences of clients. My duties included conceptualizing and developing design ideas, selecting materials, colors, and furnishings, and collaborating with architects and contractors to ensure the successful execution of projects. I also created detailed drawings and 3D models to visualize design concepts and presented them to clients for approval. Additionally, I stayed updated on industry trends and incorporated sustainable design practices into my work.

job-3.description: As a Graphic Design intern at Wild Art, I assisted in creating visual content for various marketing materials, including social media graphics, brochures, and advertisements. I collaborated with the design team to develop concepts and layouts that aligned with the company's branding guidelines. My responsibilities included photo editing, typography selection, and preparing files for print and digital distribution. This internship provided me with valuable hands-on experience in a professional design environment and helped me enhance my skills in graphic design software such as Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

education-3.placeTitle: Specialized high school of natural sciences and mathematics
